title: Private jet linked to Yevgeny Prigozhin crashes in Tver Oblast
body:
On 23 August 2023 a private aircraft flying from St Petersburg to Moscow crashed in Tver Oblast, near the village of Kuzhenkino. Russia's Emergency Services Ministry said 10 people died, including three crew members. Russia's Federal Air Transport Agency listed Yevgeny Prigozhin, the founder of the Wagner mercenary group, among the passengers.

Telegram channels linked to Wagner said that Prigozhin and Dmitry Utkin, the group's first commander, whose callsign was Wagner, had been killed. Meduza, reporting on the day, said these claims were unconfirmed at the time of publication. According to the Telegram channel Baza, which cited preliminary information, the aircraft was an Embraer ERJ135 with tail number RA-02795. Ksenia Sobchak's Telegram channel was among the first to report that the aircraft belonged to Wagner's founder.

The Wagner-linked channel Grey Zone claimed that Russian air defence had shot the aircraft down. Meduza noted that this had not been confirmed by official sources, and its early report did not describe an official investigation.

The crash occurred two months after Prigozhin led an armed rebellion on 23 and 24 June 2023, which ended in an agreement brokered by Belarusian President Alexander Lukashenko. Under that arrangement the criminal case against Prigozhin was dropped and he was to move to Belarus.
